note: Derived assets. Every clip was cut out of a shipped recording in film/corpus/videos, re-encoded silent at 1920x1080, and checked frame by frame for third-party branding, legible signage, identifiable faces and agent-specific UI. Re-derive with: python3 film/kit/harvest.py --scan <recording>.
encode: h264 crf 24, 1920x1080, 30 fps, no audio track, +faststart
why_silent: The recordings carry one continuous narration that names a specific industry agent. It can never travel with the picture, so every slice is cut with -an and the film builds its own audio.
safety: No customer name or third-party logo in any frame.
No legible signage, no identifiable individual, no agent UI.

Out points sit before the next card's heading begins to fade up over still-full-strength footage. That ghost-in is invisible to colour and histogram tests and is the reason cut points are hand-verified.
